browser_verification: Created a port and unobserved holding-register point through the real product UI: value and update time displayed as em dash; snapshot contained neither value nor valueSet; fake Bus writes remained empty.

Edited and saved the point name through the UI: runtime value/valueSet records were byte-for-byte unchanged in the snapshot; fake Bus still recorded only [73].

Saved a model template from the sampled source, created a second port, selected it and applied the template through the UI: copied point had a distinct identity, no value/valueSet and displayed em dash; source retained 37 and target 73; no additional writes occurred.

No browser console errors were reported at the final check. Retained recent network requests had no failures; the browser buffer had discarded earlier requests, so this is not a full-session network audit.
